lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 가족 형태 연구를 하고 있습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Hello. I'm doing research on family types.
lines.beaver_roman: Annyeonghaseyo. Gajok hyeongtae yeongureul hago itseumnida.
lines.en: Yes, hello. My family is a nuclear family.

lines.beaver: 가족은 몇 명이고, 아이 수는 어떻습니까?
lines.beaver_en: How many are in your family, and how many children?
lines.beaver_roman: Gajogeun myeot myeongigo, ai suneun eotteoseumnikka?
lines.en: My husband and our only daughter—three of us.

lines.beaver: 아이를 한 명만 낳으신 이유가 있습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Is there a reason you had only one child?
lines.beaver_roman: Aireul han myeongman naeusin iyuga itseumnikka?
lines.learner: 임신했을 때 일이 힘들어서 하나만 낳았어요.
lines.en: Work was hard when I was pregnant, so just one.
lines.roman: Imsinhaesseul ttae iri himdeureoseo hanaman naasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Did you have a conception dream?
lines.learner: 네, 꽃 태몽을 꿔서 딸인 줄 알았어요.
lines.en: Yes, I dreamed of flowers, so I knew it was a girl.
lines.roman: Ne, kkot taemongeul kkwoseo ttarin jul arasseoyo.

lines.en: We both work, so she goes to daycare.

lines.beaver_en: Are you satisfied with the childcare center?
lines.learner: 네, 비교적 알찬 보육 프로그램이 있어서 좋아요.
lines.en: Yes, it has a fairly solid childcare program.
lines.roman: Ne, bigyojeok alchan boyuk peurogeuraemi isseoseo joayo.

lines.beaver: 요즘 부모들은 과보호를 한다는 말도 있습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Some say parents today are overprotective.
lines.beaver_roman: Yojeum bumodeureun gwabohoreul handaneun maldo itseumnida.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 외동이라 과보호하기 쉬운 것 같아요.
lines.en: Right. With an only child, it's easy to overprotect.
lines.roman: Majayo. Oedongira gwabohohagi swiun geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Do you see your relatives often?
lines.learner: 친척들은 명절에만 모이고 평소엔 잘 못 만나요.
lines.en: Relatives gather only on holidays; we rarely meet otherwise.
lines.roman: Chincheokdeureun myeongjeoreman moigo pyeongsoen jal mon mannayo.

lines.beaver_en: How does it compare to your parents' generation?
lines.learner: 저는 오빠랑 같이 컸는데 딸은 혼자예요.
lines.en: I grew up with my older brother, but my daughter is alone.
lines.roman: Jeoneun opparang gachi keonneunde ttareun honjayeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Lastly, what is the feature of families today?
lines.learner: 요즘 가족의 특징은 식구가 적다는 데 있어요.
lines.en: The feature of families today lies in having fewer members.
lines.roman: Yojeum gajogui teukjingeun sikguga jeokdaneun de isseoyo.
